name: cropat-types
cmd: set -e; {python} -I research/exp/cropat_aggregate.py --src /mnt/e/Datasets/houfin/external/cropat_us/extracted/CropDensity --grid ${HOUFIN_DATA}/ref_grid_27km.tif --out {out}/cropat_27km.npz --pattern CropDensity --y0 1850 --y1 2021 --types /mnt/e/Datasets/houfin/external/cropat_us/extracted/CropType; for c in desk_tempho_1995_s1 desk_tempho_1985_s1; do {python} research/exp/cropat_test.py --cache {cache}/$c --cropat {out}/cropat_27km.npz --out {out}/$c --types; done
summarize: for c in desk_tempho_1995_s1 desk_tempho_1985_s1; do {python} research/exp/cropat_test.py --summarize {out}/$c; done
note: E047/E047b rerun: CropAT crop amount and crop-type composition change vs LUH (5 crop classes, all 33 channels), within type and kernel-local (LOO 150 km)
